title: L0–L3 Regime Architecture in Entropy-Bounded Empiricism
abstract: This document defines the L0–L3 regime architecture underlying Entropy-Bounded Empiricism (EBE) in Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC). The framework distinguishes four operational regimes: L0 (latent potential), L1–L2 (active/life phase), and L3 (residual structure), connected by phase-extended transitions. This architecture prevents regime leakage—the misapplication of inference rules across incompatible dynamical phases. While developed for cosmological modeling, the framework applies to any system governed by energy flow, entropy gradients, and informational constraints.
key_results: Four operational regimes (L0 latent, L1 stable active, L2 complex active, L3 residual) with distinct inference validity rules
Phase-extended transitions between regimes rather than sharp boundaries
Regime leakage detection: misapplication of inference rules across incompatible dynamical phases
Cyclical architecture where L3 residual structure can serve as L0 latent configuration for new cycles
Framework applicable to biology, ecology, economics, cognition, and technology lifecycles
